room_rent.display: Single Private Room or 1% of SI/day (schedule-driven)
room_rent.note: Policy Schedule specifies either 'Single Private Room' or 'up to 1% of SI per day'; NCB does not count toward room rent limit. Proportionate deduction on associate medical expenses if higher room opted.

icu.display: Up to 2% of SI/day or no sub-limit (schedule-driven)
icu.note: Policy Schedule states either '2% of SI per day' or 'no sub-limit' for ICU charges; NCB excluded from ICU limit calculation.

copayment.note: Illustrations show 20% co-pay for new entrants up to age 70; additional 10% co-pay kicks in from the renewal after insured turns 71. Waiver of the age-71 loading available on payment of extra premium if age at first policy ≤70.

sub_limits.display: Cataract, knee replacement, hernia, hysterectomy, BPH, renal stones, cerebrovascular, cancer, renal complications, bone fractures — all capped per schedule
sub_limits.note: Clause 3.1.1(iii) lists 10 named ailments/procedures with individual sub-limits specified in the Policy Schedule (e.g. example of ₹50,000 sub-limit cited). Advanced technology methods also subject to Benefit 1 limits.

deductible.note: Deductible is optional and applies to Benefits 1–5 in aggregate or per claim as specified in Policy Schedule. Base plan has no mandatory deductible.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period (Excl03) for illness treatment from first policy commencement; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases excluded for 24 months of continuous coverage from inception (Excl01). Portability credit reduces this period.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, hysterectomy, BPH, joint replacement, ENT surgeries, varicose veins, kidney stones, cancer, cardiac conditions, etc.) excluded for 24 months (Excl02). Portability credit applies.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses including childbirth, C-section and lawful termination of pregnancy are permanently excluded under Excl18.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% flat cumulative NCB per claim-free policy year; capped at 50% of SI. Reduced by 10% of SI in a claim year but total SI never falls below base SI. Alternatively, insured may opt for a small premium discount (₹49/₹99) instead of NCB.

restoration.note: Automatic Recharge reinstates up to 100% of base SI once per policy year after SI + NCB exhausted. Available only for claims not related to any illness/injury already claimed that year. Unused recharge lapses at year end.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission for the same condition, subject to inpatient claim being admitted.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge for the same condition.

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures (541 listed in Annexure I)
day_care.note: Day Care Treatment covered for procedures listed in Annexure I; general out-patient treatment excluded.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary Hospitalisation covered under Benefit 5 via reimbursement up to SI, subject to treatment exceeding 3 consecutive days and inpatient claim being admissible. Several diseases (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.) excluded from domiciliary cover.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered under Benefit 3 up to SI via cashless or reimbursement, linked to an accepted inpatient hospitalisation claim.

organ_donor.note: Specific exclusion 4.2(a)(12) excludes all expenses related to donor treatment including surgery to remove organs from the donor in transplant cases.

ambulance.note: Ambulance cover under Benefit 4 up to amount specified in Policy Schedule; linked to accepted inpatient claim. Exact rupee limit not stated in wording — schedule-driven.

modern_treatments.note: Clause 3.1.1(iv) covers 12 specified advanced technology methods (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy injections, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, etc.) under Benefit 1. Other advanced technology methods explicitly excluded.

consumables.note: Annexure II lists extensive non-medical/consumable items (gloves, masks, ECG electrodes, nebulisation kit, etc.) as excluded. No consumables cover rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers medical treatment taken entirely within India only (Clause 6.1.7(a)). International Second Opinion is an optional benefit but does not cover overseas treatment costs.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years (60 months) no look-back applied except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions. Moratorium applies separately to enhanced SI from date of enhancement.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium mode and 30 days for all other modes. Coverage not available during grace period except where premium paid in instalments during policy period.

free_look.note: 30-day free look period from date of receipt of policy document for new individual policies; not applicable on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity credit for PED and specific waiting periods.

notable_exclusions.display: Organ donor surgery, non-listed advanced tech methods, STDs (except HIV), sleep disorder instruments, cochlear implants, tobacco/alcohol-related illness, alopecia, Remicade/Avastin injections, maternity

optional_riders.display: OPD Care, International Second Opinion, Home Care (nursing), Active Health Check-up (3x/yr)
